xmldoc.short_description: Display messages in the protobuf text format.

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
a struct (each element is a record) or encoded bytes ('Delimited', true for a stream).
the maximum number of records shown (10 by default, Inf for all).

description.p: protobuf.show prints messages in the text format, one block per record, which is a quick way to look at a struct array or a stream. protobuf.totext returns the text of a single message as a string.
